sources.title: NeuTTS Air - On-Device Text-to-Speech with Voice Cloning
sources.snippet: NeuTTS Air is an offline text-to-speech (TTS) AI model developed by Neuphonic that runs entirely on a local device without internet access. It converts text into natural-sounding speech, ensures full data privacy, and can instantly clone a person's voice using just a few seconds of reference audio.
